name: local-decider
description: Routes routine permission, command-risk, routing and turn-outcome decisions through a local decision-model gateway. Shadow by default; fails open.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Where the local-decider gateway listens, for sessions started without LOCAL_DECIDER_URL in their environment (such as Desktop launches). Default http://127.0.0.1:8765

gateway_token.title: Gateway token
gateway_token.description: Bearer token for the gateway at Gateway URL (or the default URL). Sent only over https or to loopback; never sent to LOCAL_DECIDER_URL, and LOCAL_DECIDER_TOKEN overrides it only for the default URL
